summary: Right-shifts an in-place 96-bit value by one bit. The value is three consecutive dwords at this+0, this+4 and this+8 (little-endian: low, middle, high). The low dword is rebuilt as (old middle dword << 31) | (old low dword >> 1), the middle dword as a 64-bit right shift of the (middle, high) pair, and the high dword as old high >> 1, thereby propagating each carry bit between dwords. Returns the original pointer to the 96-bit value.

local_names.this: pointer to the 96-bit value being shifted
local_names.a1: pointer to the 96-bit value; identical to this
local_names.v2: high dword (this+8) saved before the shift
local_names.v3: middle dword (this+4) saved before the shift
local_names.v4: rebuilt low dword written back to this+0

operations.description: Save the three dwords of the 96-bit value: high dword read from this+8 into v2, middle dword from this+4 into v3, and the pointer kept as the result
Middle dword becomes a 64-bit right shift by 1 of the (middle, high) dword pair: the bit shifted out of the middle dword (its low bit) is replaced by the bit shifted in from the high dword
Low dword rebuilt as (old middle dword << 31) OR (old low dword >> 1), folding the middle dword's low carry bit into the top of the low dword
High dword shifted right by 1 and written back to this+8; the rebuilt low dword written to this+0
Return the unchanged pointer to the 96-bit value; the shift is invoked by sub_5976E8 and sub_597AA0
